headline: Reefish
title: Reefish | Rock and Water Coral Mimic | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Reefish is a Rock and Water Aniimo you can find around Crescent Bay in the Whisperwake Isles. It burrows underground to pose as coral, and it can swim. Its coral trap hits for power sixty seven, costs twenty energy and stacks an Earth debuff. Evolve it into Coraliz, a stage three Rock and Water Aniimo. Starting your Whisperwake collection? Comment below!
description: How to get Reefish in Aniimo: a Rock and Water Aniimo found around Crescent Bay in the Whisperwake Isles. It can swim and evolves into Coraliz. Checked on aniimo.gg and Aniimo Wiki in November 2026.
